Episode 254. The Egos of the Sun God (4)
Everyone living in the Imperial Capital was looking up at the sky.
The entire sky was colored as if gold were flowing through it, and in its center, a being with a human-like form holding a sword could be seen.
That was Kragos.
“Ah, ack...!”
“M-my, eyes, my eyes!”
“Kraaaaak!”
The citizens who looked up at the sky were screaming. As if they had stared directly into the sun, the pain of their eyeballs burning was forcing them to their knees.
It wasn't just pain.

The citizens who looked at Kragos and the golden sky he had created for even a moment were actually going blind. Before even three minutes had passed since the golden sky opened, more than forty percent of the capital's citizens had lost their sight in this way.
Only those who had been sleeping, those who were living underground, and those who were extremely well-trained, like the knights of Hairan, were avoiding blindness.
[I am your creator, Kragos. Mortals, listen. The true apocalypse has begun. You have no right to enjoy even this filthy land that I have made...]
There were too many people who had suddenly gone blind. Anywhere in the capital where people had gathered instantly turned into a scene of chaos.
Amidst the screams, people were hearing Kragos's voice as clearly as if it were ringing from inside their own ears.
A pure and absolute malice they had never once encountered in their lives.
Just by facing that malice, the untrained could not help but have their bodies freeze. Even the instinct to hide or flee did not function at all.
[All of you, proceed swiftly to death.]
Chwaaaaaa...!
Soon, as Kragos finished his words, raindrops began to pour from the golden-colored sky.
They were raindrops as thick as old blood and as round as a person's head. The golden lumps that fell like this melted everything they touched.
As that horrific rain began, the sounds of suffering in the capital were cut off at a rapid pace. As if the gates of a festival were closing.
Stone, iron, earth, and people.
Everything was melting. Everything the raindrops touched turned into golden water and filled the ground, already forming a torrent that was flowing somewhere.
Kragos, as if pleased by the sight, sat down in the sky as if on a perch and smiled.
Even those who had endured the blindness could not withstand the golden rain. The capital's guards were also endlessly melting and being swept away into the torrent.
[Your king has come to put up a meaningless struggle.]
Kragos's gaze turned forward.
The Hairan Golden Fleet was approaching, parting the sun energy. If it weren't for the Golden Fleet's uniquely powerful shields, they would have all been sunk before they even reached this point.
Dante Hairan.

He took in the horrific sight, which he couldn't believe even as he saw it with his own eyes, with a calm gaze. From the time Hairan was founded, through the previous Sword Emperor Ron Hairan, to himself.
Protecting this city, this empire, which was turning into something like a molten lump of gold, was always their duty and their pride.
On this land, an act more cruel than any other time was unfolding. A ruin that far surpassed the tragedy of the Sword Emperor's Holy Land or the atrocities of the Evil God was dawning.
“...Everyone, calm your anger. You cannot fight properly if you are soaked in hatred.”
The moment he and his knights lost their composure, the few remaining survivors would also die without exception.
Dante was maintaining his composure with that single thought.
“Patriarch, we still cannot communicate. Spatial jumps are also impossible.”
Kragos's solar energy was not only concentrated on the capital but was enveloping the entire empire. The solar energy that had spread in this way was blocking communication and spatial jumps.
“It can't be helped. Still, Jin and the coalition will have already grasped the situation. Because they cannot contact us. We will hold out until reinforcements arrive.”
“...Surely, you don't mean you are going out to fight?”
At the knight's question, Dante was silent for a few seconds.

If honor was his entire life, he would have to go out and fight. Even if he were defeated and died. That would have been more comfortable for his heart. As the Sword Emperor, to do nothing was an unbearable thing.

“If it were the me from my weaker days, I would have. But not anymore. We must hold out until the coalition's support arrives. We have confirmed the situation, so begin the retreat flight. So that we do not lose our forces meaninglessly...!”
He spat out the words with the feeling of biting off his own tongue.
From Dante's eyes, which had turned red as if they would burst from suppressing his hatred, tears of blood were flowing. However, it was certainly a wise choice.
[Hoh? To turn your prow? Are you afraid to stand against me? Even as the mortals who depended on you die so meaninglessly, in the end, was your own life the only thing that mattered?]
ragos’s mocking voice spread across the entire empire. So that all the areas outside the capital, where the golden rain of ruin had not yet fallen, could hear.
[But you cannot run from me, Dante Hairan.]
Swhaaaaak...!

A single sword strike from Kragos struck the rear of the Sword Emperor's Ship, which had just turned to increase its speed. The shield that had withstood the golden rain was torn like a piece of paper, but thanks to the outer armor, the damage to the hull was not great.

However, that was just a single strike. Kragos, as if intrigued, licked his lips and fired a sword-aura at the same location again. With even short-distance spatial jumps restricted, they could not even attempt to evade.
“Do not use any power for attacks. All fleets, we will pour all power only into escape and defense.”
Even a minimal response was meaningless right now.
As Orgal had predicted, Kragos was displaying a level of combat power that was on a different dimension from the egos of the Sun God the coalition had confirmed so far.

It was because, unlike the previous egos, he had not awoken in a weakened or restricted state. Furthermore, he had even received Malugia's power and become stronger than his original self, so to fight back with only the empire's current forces was no different from throwing a stone into a lake.
A valid blow could only be dealt if a great power capable of inflicting fundamental damage was gathered in one place.

It seemed like a feat that was only possible if, at the very least, all the Genesis Knights of the coalition combined their strength. Although Dante had not yet reached the state of a Genesis Knight, he could gauge that much.

[How pathetic. It seems you are waiting for that mortal, Jin Runcandel... but he cannot come here. Blocking the path of mortals is not a very difficult task for me. But Malugia herself has blocked the path, so by what means could you possibly defy her?]
Dante did not know the power of Malugia.
However, the egos who had become his allies trembled in fear when they spoke of Malugia, and even Kragos, whom he absolutely could not face alone right now, revered her.

[Well, it matters not. Whether you die clinging to a fleeting hope, or die in resignation. In any case, the fact that you will return to nothingness does not change. If you wish, resent me as much as you like, my hideous creations.]
The moment Kragos finished his speech.
The Hairan fleet witnessed another enemy appearing on the opposite side of Kragos, that is, directly in front of them.
“...Zipfel!?”
A pure white disk that seemed to stretch on endlessly like the horizon, the Tower of Stories, had blocked the path of the fleeing Hairan fleet.

[Ah, I almost forgot about the mortals who were temporarily granted life by Malugia. You must want to enjoy the end of this world as well. In consideration for her, I shall specially leave just enough for you to enjoy. Dante Hairan and the mortals who follow him.]
“Damn it, it was the Empire...!”
Jin shouted, gritting his teeth.
He had just received a report that Kragos had awoken in the Empire. The coalition was immediately preparing to dispatch all its forces.
The Empire was the land where the most people in this world lived.
If an ego of destruction were to awaken in such an area, and in a state strengthened by Malugia's power at that, the number of casualties would be beyond counting.
Furthermore, Dante was there.
Although there was the Golden Fleet, Hairan, and numerous knights, the only person who could be called a top-tier superhuman of the coalition was Dante alone.
There was no way he could hold out on his own.

In truth, a situation like this had been somewhat foretold. The coalition had deployed its superhuman-level personnel in as many areas as possible to prepare for the Zipfel's indiscriminate massacres.
When fighting the Zipfel, such a deployment was not a big problem as immediate support was possible, but this case was different.
Spatial jumps were blocked as a matter of course, and even communication was down. It was impossible to know how much time it would take to support the Empire.
“Flagship Sarah, ready for dispatch!”
“For now, I and some personnel will go first and open a path. The rest of the forces, after finishing preparations for dispatch, will be on standby until my order is given.”
His voice was calm, but his heart could not be.
The moment Jin boarded the flagship Sarah, a spatial jump began. The jump-able coordinates they found after several attempts were at the very edge of the Empire's southern territorial waters.
From there, they had to proceed to the capital purely by flight. However, what spread before the flagship Sarah was a vast golden wall that completely blocked the space between the sky and the sea.
Valeria immediately began to track Dante's records, and the Genesis Knights protected her as she came out onto the bridge and gave the order to fire.
“Lord Dante is still alive, Jin! Uh, but... following Kragos, even the Tower of Tales is attacking Lord Dante...?”
Kwaaaaaa-!
The moment Valeria finished speaking, the main cannon of the flagship Sarah struck the golden wall, but not even a small crack appeared on the wall.
[This is a shield made by Malugia... Jin, to break this, even if all the coalition forces, including yourselves, were to attack, it would take... several days.]

[Even if Vahn were to unfold the final chapter of the Plutonian Domination Sword, it would take at least a day. And even if it is Vahn, if she maintains that sword for a whole day, she will be in a state where she cannot fight.]
Nepdol and Bluggiet came to Jin's side and said.
Jin's eyes were shaking.
